Messages.Author: Jaysen Knight
Messages.Body:
My Vamp A calls a vote, which passes, and susequently modifies with
a Cryptic Rider.

My Vamp B then calls a vote.....insert Question here: can I still play
a second vote card from my hand (like I normally would if the result
of the vote was in question) to pump up that vote?

I think yes - simply because a vote was called and the rules don't
distinguish between a 'vote in question' and a 'vote in the bag'.
Still have to ask though.

Jaysen

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. A vote that "passes automatically" by-passes the polling stage (the
time when you can cast votes) and skips directly to the "effects of a
successful vote" stage.
